name: Trirealm Rift Gospel
desc:
Activate this card by banishing (face-down) 5 cards from your GY and/or the top of your Deck. You can only use the ② effect of this card's name once per turn.
① You can Normal Summon 1 "Trirealm Rift" monster during your Main Phase each turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn).
② During your Main Phase: You can banish (face-down) 1 "Trirealm Rift" monster you control whose original Level is 4 or lower, and if you do, Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters.

name: A Journey Back to the Light - "Zenet"
desc:
Show 2 or 3 Normal Monster Cards in your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then apply the appropriate effect based on the number shown, then if you showed a card(s) in the hand, you can draw 1 card.
● 2: Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck as a Normal Monster Card.
● 3: Special Summon 1 "Zenet" monster from your Deck or 1 Normal Monster from your GY.
You can only activate 1 "A Journey Back to the Light - "Zenet"" per turn.

name: The Sun God's Poet - Helpoemer
desc: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "The Sun God's Poet - Helpoemer", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God's Poet - Helpoemer" once per turn.

name: The Sun God's Destructor - Makyura
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God's Destructor - Makyura" once per turn.

name: The Sun God's Terror Machine - Gil Garth
desc: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God's Terror Machine - Gil Garth" once per turn.

name: The Sun God's Torture Device - Viser Des Shock
desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Sun God's Torture Device - Viser Des Shock" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

name: The Sun God of Darkness - The Winged Dragon of Ra
desc:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

name: The Sun God's Steelcage - Lava Golem
desc:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "The Sun God's Steelcage - Lava Golem" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

name: The Immortal Sun God
desc: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
desc: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

name: Sun God Domination
desc:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

name: The Sun God's Protector - Egyptian God Slime
desc:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "The Sun God's Protector - Egyptian God Slime" per turn.

name: Super Critical
desc:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 card with an effect that requires a die roll from your Deck to your hand. Once per Chain per player, if either player rolls a 1 for a card effect's die roll: They can activate 1 of these effects;
● They destroy up to 3 monsters their opponent controls.
● They destroy 1 monster their opponent controls, and if they do, they negate the effects of 1 monster their opponent controls.
● They Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.
You can only activate 1 "Super Critical" per turn.

name: Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon
desc: If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 DARK Machine monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon". During the Battle Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there from the field this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon it, and if you do, toss a coin 3 times, then you can destroy monsters on the field up to the number of heads.

name: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion". Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 2 monsters; Special Summon this card (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 2000 ATK.

name: Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, and if you Tributed a monster(s) that is owned by your opponent, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when this card is Special Summoned this way. If Summoned this way: Your opponent must send all monsters they control to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts" once per turn.

name: Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"
desc: If your opponent added a card(s) from the Deck to the hand this turn, except during the Draw Phase: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand, then if the total number of cards in their hand, field, and GY is 20 or more, you can banish their entire hand. You can only activate 1 "Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"" per turn.

name: Zombyra
desc: When this card declares an attack: You lose 500 LP, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK. When a monster is destroyed by battle: You can equip this card from your GY to the monster that destroyed that monster, then you can destroy the 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). The equipped monster's name becomes "Zombyra", also its effects are negated. When the equipped monster declares an attack: Its controller loses 500 LP, and if they do, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK.

name: Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 EARTH monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then if a WATER monster is on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon" once per turn.

name: Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 LIGHT monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, send this card to the GY, then if an EARTH monster is on the field, you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon" once per turn.

name: Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon
desc: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other card from your hand or face-up field on the bottom of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon" once per turn.

name: Raise Moon Elegance Carol
desc: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 700. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can draw 1 card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Xyz Monsters. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them.

name: Raise Moon Wings Rapi
desc: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can draw 1 card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Xyz Monsters. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. Once per opponent's turn, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Rank 7 LIGHT monster.

name: Raise Moon Blade Shayna
desc: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If Summoned this way: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; place it on the bottom of the Deck. You can discard this card; draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Raise Moon Blade Shayna" once per turn.

name: Raise Moon Lamp Croucier
desc: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If Summoned this way: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; place it on the bottom of the Deck. You can discard this card; draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Raise Moon Lamp Croucier" once per turn.

name: Raise Moon Starter Squeeze
desc:
(Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each of these effects of "Raise Moon Starter Squeeze" once per turn);
● You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck until the end of the next turn, except Rank 7 Xyz Monsters, also this turn, each time a card(s) is added to your opponent's hand, except by drawing it, immediately draw 1 card.
● Draw 1 card.
You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand during the Duel you activate this effect, except by drawing them.

name: Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets!
desc:
2 Level 7 "Raise Moon" monsters
Cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Xyz, or Link Summon. If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can draw 1 card. Gains these effects while in the Extra Monster Zone.
● Unaffected by other cards' effects.
● When a card or effect activated by your opponent resolves that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand, you can make that effect become "Draw 1 card".
● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; draw 1 card.

name: Raise Moon Hope Squeeze - Jackpot
desc:
2+ Level 7 monsters
Your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. If this card is Xyz Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the hand: You can detach any number of materials from this card; place that many cards your opponent controls on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use this effect of "Raise Moon Hope Squeeze - Jackpot" once per turn. Each time your opponent makes a card(s) leave their Deck, except by drawing them: You can attach the top card of their Deck to this card.

name: "Raise Moon" the City that Never Sleeps
The Glitter of Raise Moon
desc: Special Summon 1 "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, attach this card to it, then you can shuffle all "Raise Moon" cards in your GY into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "The Glitter of Raise Moon" once per turn. You cannot add cards from the Deck to the hand during the Duel you activate either of this card's effects, except by drawing them.

name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
desc: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

name: Trirealm Rift of Emptiness Gehenna
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top card of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift of Emptiness Gehenna" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control no monsters: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can add up to 2 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with different names to your hand, except "Trirealm Rift of Emptiness Gehenna", also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Trirealm Rift" cards or effects.

name: Trirealm Rift of Sky Sheol
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 2 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift of Sky Sheol" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a "Trirealm Rift" monster: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can add up to 2 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" Spells/Traps with different names to your hand, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Trirealm Rift" cards or effects.

name: Trirealm Rift of Blue Tuonela
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 3 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift of Blue Tuonela" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and your opponent controls more monsters than you do: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Trirealm Rift" cards or effects.

name: Trirealm Rift of Scarlet Naraka
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift of Scarlet Naraka" once per turn. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Trirealm Rift" cards or effects.

name: Sky Thunder Trirealm Rift Yomi
desc: You can reveal this card in your hand; banish it (face-down), and if you do, add 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" cards to your hand, except a Level 5 monster. You can only use this effect of "Sky Thunder Trirealm Rift Yomi" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 5 cards of your Deck. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can shuffle 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with the same Attribute into the Deck, and if you do, negate the activation.

name: Burial Summit Trirealm Rift Helheim
desc: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; banish it (face-down), and if you do, Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters, except a Level 6 monster. You can only use this effect of "Burial Summit Trirealm Rift Helheim" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 6 cards of your Deck. Other "Trirealm Rift" cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target them with card effects.

name: Mad Tempest Trirealm Rift Ploutonion
desc: (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card and 1 other "Trirealm Rift" card in your hand; banish both (face-down), and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Mad Tempest Trirealm Rift Ploutonion" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 7 cards of your Deck. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters into the Deck, then you can shuffle 1 monster your opponent controls with the same Attribute into the Deck.

name: Emptiness Devouring Trirealm Rift Jahannam
desc:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 8 cards of your Deck. Gains these effects based on the total number of face-down banished cards.
● 10+: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 20+: Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
● 30+: Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can add 1 of your face-down banished cards to your hand.
● 40+: Skip both players' Draw Phases.

name: Trirealm Rift Territory - Valvols
desc: Activate this card by banishing (face-down) 5 cards from your GY and/or the top of your Deck. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" cards to your hand, except "Trirealm Rift Territory - Valvols". You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Territory - Valvols" once per turn. While you control a Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monster and you have no cards in your Deck, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects during your turn.

name: Trirealm Rift Judgment
desc: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): You can target 1 of them; choose 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with the same Attribute, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot choose the same Attribute again with this effect of "Trirealm Rift Judgment", and you cannot activate cards or effects, except "Trirealm Rift" cards or effects. Once per battle, during damage calculation, if your "Trirealm Rift" monster battles an opponent's monster and you have no cards in your Deck: You can make that opponent's monster's ATK become 0.

name: Destined Duel
desc: When this card is activated: Each player can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, then if there are any other face-up monsters on the field, change all of them to face-down Defense Position. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Normal or Special Summon. Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack: You can negate the attack, and if you do, destroy 1 face-down card your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Return this card to the hand.

name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant
desc:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your opponent's turn. Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase. Once per Chain, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster that was Special Summoned this turn, or 1 face-down card, that your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant" thrice per turn.

name: Dominusteer Rosepamela
desc: Face-down cards in your Spell & Trap Zone cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dominusteer Rosepamela" once per turn. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dominus Purge" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Dominators" or "Dominus Purge" Trap from your Deck or GY. It can be activated this turn.

name: Ultimate Sky
Odd-Eyes Override Dragon
desc:
2+ monsters, including a Pendulum Monster
You can target 1 other card you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card. During your turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate that effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Odd-Eyes Override Dragon" once per turn. If you destroyed a Pendulum Monster Card by this card's first effect, during your Main Phase this turn, you can conduct 1 Pendulum Summon of a "Performapal" monster(s), "Magician" Pendulum Monster(s), and/or "Odd-Eyes" monster(s), in addition to your Pendulum Summon (you can only gain this effect once per turn).

name: Lunalight Scarlet Tiger
desc: If you activate a "Lunalight" monster's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then if you activated this effect during the turn your opponent activated a card or effect, you can add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Lunalight" monster from your face-up Extra Deck or GY, except a Level 5 monster, but it cannot activate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Lunalight Scarlet Tiger" once per turn.

name: Speedroid Darumaknocker
desc: If this card is in your hand: You can send 1 "Speedroid" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Speedroid Darumaknocker"; Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Speedroid" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, then if you control a "Clear Wing" monster, you can destroy 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Speedroid Darumaknocker" once per turn.

name: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion
desc:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Level 7 or higher monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for every other monster on the field. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. After this card destroys a card by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY, neither player can activate its effects while it is in the GY.

name: Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum
desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Choose 1 Level 4 monster in your GY, except the detached material, and add 1 Level 4 monster with the same Type and Attribute, but a different name, from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; attach it to this card.
You can only use this effect of "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum" once per turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

name: Zenet Prophet - Nefertari
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Zenet" Spells from your Deck. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to 1 Ritual Monster you control as an Equip Spell. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Prophet - Nefertari" once per turn.

name: Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Zenet" Traps from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 3 Normal Monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep" once per turn.

name: Zenetnakht Sphinx
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Zenet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenetnakht Sphinx" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Zenetnakht Sphinx". (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Normal Monster Card you control to the GY; change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

name: Tauzenet Wadjet
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Zenet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Tauzenet Wadjet" once per turn. You can discard this card; send 1 "Zenet" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Tauzenet Wadjet". (Quick Effect): You can send up to 3 face-up Normal Monster Cards you control to the GY, then target that many cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

name: Zenetmes Nekhbet
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Zenet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenetmes Nekhbet" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your GY to your hand, except "Zenetmes Nekhbet". (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 face-up Normal Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, equip this card you control to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 2500 ATK.

name: Pere-Zenet Em Heru
desc: Once per turn: You can Ritual Summon 1 "Zenet" Ritual Monster from your hand or GY, by sending Normal Monster Cards with different names from each other from your hand, Deck, and/or face-up field to the GY whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level, then you can equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell. If you Special Summon a non-Token Normal Monster(s): You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Pere-Zenet Em Heru" once per turn.

name: Zenet Per Akh
desc: Add 1 "Zenet" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you discard a "Zenet" Ritual Monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with ATK less than or equal to any of the discarded monsters' as a Normal Monster Card, but for the rest of this turn, it cannot attack directly, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Per Akh" once per turn.

name: Am Duazenet
desc: Ritual Summon 1 "Zenet" Ritual Monster from your hand or GY, by sending Normal Monster Cards with different names from each other from your hand, Deck, and/or face-up field to the GY whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level, then you can equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell. If a Normal Monster Card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only activate 1 "Am Duazenet" per turn.

name: Zenet Cataract
desc: Choose opponent's Main Monster Zones equal to the number of Normal Monsters and "Zenet" Ritual Monsters you control; negate the first monster effect activated in each of those zones that resolves this turn. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Cataract" once per turn.

name: Zenet Thunderfall
desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card while you control a Normal Monster or "Zenet" Ritual Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 "Zenet" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY, except "Zenet Thunderfall". You can only use each effect of "Zenet Thunderfall" once per turn.

name: Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier
desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can discard 1 card; banish 2 cards from your opponent's field and/or GY. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish 1 card from your hand; return 1 card in either field or GY to the hand. If this Synchro Summoned card is sent to the GY during your opponent's turn: You can banish 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random), field, or GY. You can only use each effect of "Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

name: Dark Armed Dragon Punisher
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower DARK monster from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish up to 3 DARK monsters from your GY, then target that many cards on the field; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Dark Armed Dragon Punisher" once per turn.

name: Emissaries from Darkness
desc:
If you take battle or effect damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain 2000 LP, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "Emissaries from Darkness" from your hand, Deck, or GY.
● Destroy up to 2 Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.
During the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Emissaries from Darkness" once per turn.

name: Mind Mirror Force
desc:
If your opponent controls 5 or more face-up cards, this card's activation and effect cannot be negated, also you can activate this card the turn it was Set. At any of the following timings: Negate the effects of as many face-up cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, destroy them, also your monsters cannot attack directly until the end of the next turn after this card resolves.
● When the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (even if tied) declares an attack.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect that would destroy a card(s) on the field.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect in the hand or field during your turn.

name: Ancient Secrets
desc:
Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY in Defense Position (if you Special Summon from the Deck, it must be Level 4 or lower), or if you control a Normal Monster Card, you can apply 1 of these effects instead.
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
● Draw 2 cards.
● Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field.
You can only activate 1 "Ancient Secrets" per turn.

name: Thoroughbred Elf
desc: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to the GY, then this card gains 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use this effect of "Thoroughbred Elf" once per turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Spellcaster monster from your Deck, except "Thoroughbred Elf".

name: Assault Lion
desc: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Beast-Warrior monster. If this card battles a monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled. If a Beast-Warrior monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field while this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Tribute Summon this card face-up, and if you do, it gains 500 ATK, also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Assault Lion" once per turn.

name: Power Connection
desc: Target any number of face-up monsters you control (if you target 2 or more monsters, they must have the same Type); they gain 500 ATK for each monster targeted, until the end of this turn. If you activated "Armament Reincarnation" this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Power Connection" once per turn.
